Compounding the disappointment is Fotor’s pricing model. The app charges a hefty $37.99 per year for a "Pro" subscription, but even then, you're limited by a strict credit system. Nearly half the app's features require credits to use, and those credits are extremely limited unless you're willing to pay more on top of your subscription. This creates a frustrating experience where even paying customers feel nickel-and-dimed.
 
Most troubling, however, is the misleading way Fotor is marketed. The Pro subscription strongly suggests access to the majority of features, but once inside, users quickly discover that many of the key tools are locked behind additional paywalls. This bait-and-switch tactic makes the app feel more like a trap than a tool. Overall, Fotor is not recommended not for its output quality, not for its pricing, and certainly not for its deceptive presentation. 1/10 IS MY RATING!
